# RawWeights
> From Weights to Intelligence

RawWeights is a technical education site focused on AI/ML — from raw fundamentals to production agentic systems. It offers interactive playgrounds where concepts run in the browser, deep guides written for developers and PMs, and field notes from building real AI products. No padding. No hype.

Site: https://rawweights.com
MCP Manifest: https://rawweights.com/.well-known/webmcp.json
Search: https://rawweights.com/search/?q={query}

---

## Home

- https://rawweights.com/: RawWeights home page — inline hero search, dynamic stats (8 playgrounds, 25+ guides, 70+ articles), topic pills, 8-playground grid, tabbed Explore section (All / Blog / Guides / Use Cases), guides strip, and CTA.
- https://rawweights.com/how-it-started.html: How It Started — Atomic GPT Playground. Train a real Transformer entirely in the browser, no Python, no GPU. The glass-box educational tool that started the project.

---

## Interactive Playgrounds

Pages where AI/ML concepts execute live in the browser. No Python, no server.

- https://rawweights.com/tools/master_ml_hub.html: ML Master Hub — searchable card gallery of all ML models and techniques. Each card opens a self-contained playground: gradient descent, activation functions, neural network training, regularisation.
- https://rawweights.com/tools/master_sequence_hub.html: Attention Journey — visual deep dive from vanilla RNNs through GRUs, LSTMs, and attention mechanisms to modern Transformers. Step-by-step interactive animations.
- https://rawweights.com/tools/cnn_sandbox.html: CNN Explorer — convolutional neural network architecture sandbox. Build, visualise, and explore convolution, pooling, and feature maps interactively.
- https://rawweights.com/tools/deep_generative_modeling.html: Generative Modeling Playground — VAE, GAN, and CycleGAN interactive explorer. Visualise latent spaces, training dynamics, and generated outputs.
- https://rawweights.com/tools/deep_reinforcement.html: Reinforcement Learning Playground — deep RL with policy gradients, Q-learning, and interactive environments. Watch agents learn in real time.
- https://rawweights.com/srt.html: Simple Regression Tool — visualise gradient descent, cost function minimisation, and linear regression from scratch. The tool that started RawWeights.
- https://rawweights.com/tools/limitations-and-frontiers.html: Deep Learning Limitations & Frontiers — explore the Universal Approximation Theorem (UAT) and the boundaries of what deep learning can and cannot do.
- https://rawweights.com/tools/eval-proving-ground.html: Build. Measure. Ship. — AI evaluation proving ground. Score model outputs, run comparative prompt experiments, and prove performance improvements before deploying to production.

---

## Guides — Fundamentals

Long-form technical guides with interactive diagrams and code examples.

- https://rawweights.com/guide/rag.html: Ultimate Guide to RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) — architecture, chunking strategies, vector databases, re-ranking, evaluation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, RAGAs), hallucination mitigation, and production patterns. Tailored tracks for developers, PMs, and beginners.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/llm-post-training-guide.html: LLM Post-Training Guide — supervised fine-tuning, RLHF, DPO, data curation, model merging (SLERP, TIES, DARE), quantisation, and test-time compute strategies.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/mcp.html: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Interactive Guide — solves the N×M integration problem, MCP server/client architecture, tools vs resources vs prompts, building self-evolving AI agents.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/full-lifecycle.html: Full LLM Architecture & Lifecycle — end-to-end: tokenisation, embedding, pre-training, fine-tuning, inference optimisation, deployment, monitoring, and deprecation.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/fine-tuning-llm-guide.html: Fine-Tuning LLMs — when to fine-tune vs RAG vs prompt engineering. The specialist protocol: data curation, training strategy, and evaluation.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/fine-tuning-production.html: Fine-Tuning for Production — LoRA, alignment techniques, synthetic data generation, GPU cost models, and deployment patterns at scale.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/mythos.html: Mythos — AI Threats Preview Report. Claude AI threat modelling and safety analysis — adversarial prompts, misuse vectors, and mitigation strategies.

---

## Guides — Agentic & Applied

- https://rawweights.com/guide/agent-blueprint-site-transform.html: The Blueprint — How an Agent Rebuilds a Website. Five autonomy positions, the 2×2 control/autonomy matrix, ReAct loop internals, three memory layers, HITL vs HOTL, four agent architecture patterns, five failure modes, and the MINT rule. Built around the real rawweights.com redesign.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/agent-autonomy-dial.html: Agent Autonomy Dial — five levels of AI autonomy explained through everyday analogies (travel planning). The two-axis control model, ReAct reasoning, memory types, failure modes, and where the sweet spot is.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/ai-security-stack-autopsy.html: AI Security Stack Autopsy — why legacy security tools (WAFs, DLP, SIEM, IAM) fail against AI agents. Attack surfaces: prompt injection, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, model supply chain. The new security architecture required.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/ai-security-threat-model.html: AI Security Threat Model — STRIDE applied to LLM systems. Trust boundaries, attack vectors, a structured threat matrix, and a security blueprint for agentic deployments.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/ai-security-redteam-brief.html: Agent Security Guide — OWASP LLM Top 10 attacker playbook. Red-team methodology, injection techniques, and defensive countermeasures for production AI agents.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/adobe-cx-enterprise-ecosystem.html: Agentic AI Strategy — strategic framework for building resilient autonomous systems. Levels of autonomy, LangChain/n8n/SDK comparisons, orchestration patterns, and enterprise deployment considerations.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/rag-pipeline-toolkit.html: RAG Pipeline Toolkit — interactive tool to design, tune, and debug RAG pipelines. Chunk size optimiser, retrieval strategy selector, evaluation dashboard.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/rag-architects-studio.html: RAG Architect's Studio — context budget allocator and RAG pattern matcher. Six retrieval patterns, interactive sizing tool, production readiness checklist.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/pinecone-retrieval-playbook.html: The Retrieval Playbook (Pinecone) — six RAG search strategies: dense, sparse, hybrid, multi-vector, namespace filtering, and metadata pre-filtering. Know which play to call.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/llamaindex-document-intelligence.html: Document Intelligence with LlamaIndex — parser selection guide, citation trust, chunk overlap strategies, and production readiness checklist for document RAG.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/passive-safety-watchdog.html: Building a Passive Food Safety Watchdog — GraphRAG system monitoring 29,000+ FDA/USDA recalls silently. Architecture, graph construction, query patterns, and deployment.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/jfrog.html: The Liquid Software Supply Chain (JFrog) — interactive architectural guide to the JFrog Platform: Artifactory, Xray, ML model registry, and AI Catalog.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/mcp-practitioner-playbook.html: MCP Practitioner Playbook — hands-on MCP implementation patterns, server scaffolding, tool definition best practices, and real-world integration examples.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/ag2-quickref.html: AG2 Quick Reference — 10 key concepts from AG2 (AutoGen v2) beta: agent roles, conversation patterns, tool registration, and multi-agent coordination.
- https://rawweights.com/guide/llm-wiki-compiler.html: The Compiler | LLM Wiki — when pre-compiled knowledge beats RAG. A structured reference wiki covering 80+ LLM concepts with implementation guidance.

## Agentic AI — Build & Deploy

- https://rawweights.com/agents/: Site Transformation Agent — a runnable LangGraph ReAct Python agent that audits and standardises rawweights.com. Seven tools, dry-run safety gate, HITL confirmation loop. Position 3-4 on the autonomy dial.

Demo video, live agent session proof, an interactive raw-HTML vs tool-call playground, and 5 field notes (feature detection, tool descriptions, message field, custom vs standard form fields, auto-populated fields and reCAPTCHA).

## Build Stories (Usecases)

Real AI product builds with architecture, implementation decisions, and outcomes. Each page has a companion .md at the same path.

- https://rawweights.com/usecase/debrief.html: Debrief — Conference Memory & Networking Intelligence. A mobile-first graph-powered app built at the conference where we had the problem. Remembers every conversation, maps connections, surfaces follow-ups.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/debrief-film.html: Debrief — 9 Hours, 1 Graph, 14 People Remembered. The film-style build log of Debrief. Architecture decisions, graph construction, and lessons from building in a live conference environment.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/observability.html: AI Agent Observability — Why 200 OK Lies. Traditional monitoring is blind to AI agent failures. Telemetry standards, trace architectures, and interactive observability patterns.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/sent-triage.html: SentTriage — Behavioral Email Classifier. An email classifier that asks what an email requires from you, not what it is about. 6 buckets, 8 fine-tuned epochs, local inference.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/shadowshield-ai.html: ShadowShield AI — Chrome Extension. Replaces real personal data with safe stand-ins before AI chatbots see it, then swaps back. A privacy-first browser extension experiment.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/mem0-b2b-signal-memory.html: The Signal Memory Problem. Why B2B AI agents forget everything between sessions — and how Mem0 solves deduplication, contradiction management, and context persistence.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/securitytwin.html: Security Twin — From IDOR to a CI Guard. Visual build story: reproduce an IDOR in an isolated app copy, detect it in request data, repair it automatically, block it in CI.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/panchangchef-guide.html: PanchangChef — Cultural Calendar AI. An AI chef that cooks for Hindu calendar events. Multi-LLM orchestration, cultural context retrieval, and recipe generation.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/vocabforge-fine-tuning-guide.html: VocabForge — Fine-tuned model, Local inference, Zero cloud. Build a vocabulary habit tracker with a fine-tuned model running entirely on device.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/LaunchKit.html: LaunchKit — AI-Powered Launch Toolkit. Automates the go-to-market artifact pipeline: positioning, copy, landing page, email sequence, from a single product brief.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/agentintel-guide.html: AgentIntel — Competitive Intelligence Agent. An agent that monitors competitor moves, synthesises signals, and surfaces strategic insights automatically.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/briefd.html: Briefd — AI-Powered Meeting Briefs. Generates contextual meeting preparation briefs from calendar events, contacts, and company data.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/buildbridge-ai.html: BuildBridge AI — Cross-Stack Integration Agent. Bridges legacy systems with modern AI APIs without rewriting infrastructure.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/claimlens.html: ClaimLens — Insurance Claim Intelligence. AI-augmented claim analysis that surfaces inconsistencies, flags fraud signals, and accelerates underwriter decisions.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/debatecast.html: DebateCast — Structured Debate AI. Generates balanced debate frameworks on any topic, with sources, counter-arguments, and scoring rubrics.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/iteration-machine.html: The Iteration Machine. How rapid AI-assisted iteration compresses the build-measure-learn loop in product development.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/plumber-lab.html: Plumber Lab — AI Pipeline Security. Detects and patches security vulnerabilities in data pipelines using agentic scanning.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/production-readiness-checklist.html: Production Readiness Checklist. Interactive checklist for shipping AI systems: observability, fallbacks, rate limiting, cost controls, and rollback.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/rubik-navigator-guide.html: Rubik Navigator — Spatial Reasoning Agent. An agent that solves and explains Rubik's Cube states, demonstrating multi-step spatial reasoning.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/secondear.html: SecondEar — Real-Time Hearing Aid AI. An AI hearing aid that filters noise, enhances speech, and provides real-time captions in a mobile-first app.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/serpdelta.html: SerpDelta — Search Rank Change Detector. Monitors SERP movements and attributes ranking changes to content, technical, and authority factors using AI.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/tech-debt-copilot.html: Tech Debt Copilot. An AI pair programmer that detects, categorises, and prioritises technical debt across a codebase, with refactor suggestions.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/tripripple.html: TripRipple — Travel Disruption Intelligence. Predicts and mitigates travel disruptions by monitoring signals across weather, infrastructure, and events.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/trustlens.html: TrustLens — AI Trust & Safety Layer. A moderation and trust layer that evaluates AI outputs for factual accuracy, bias, and policy compliance before delivery.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/careerwiki-guide.html: CareerWiki — AI Career Intelligence. Synthesises job market signals, skill gaps, and career paths into a personalised intelligence feed.
- https://rawweights.com/usecase/drop-off-oasis.html: Drop-Off Oasis — Abandoned Cart Recovery AI. Recovers abandoned e-commerce carts with personalised AI-generated re-engagement messages.
